title: Heavy Metal
tagline: Amplified riffs, commanding voices, and a sound built for scale.
summary: Heavy metal took the volume and distortion of hard rock and made them the center of the music. Its defining language includes weighty guitar riffs, emphatic drums, dramatic vocals, and a taste for bold imagery. Different scenes made the sound faster, darker, or more technical, but its core appeal is the physical force of a band playing at full intensity.

pillars.name: Black Sabbath
pillars.why: Black Sabbath established a darker, heavier guitar vocabulary that became foundational for metal.

pillars.name: Judas Priest
pillars.why: Judas Priest sharpened the genre's twin-guitar attack and helped make leather-and-studs imagery part of its visual identity.

pillars.name: Iron Maiden
pillars.why: Iron Maiden paired intricate guitar harmonies and driving rhythms with expansive, story-led songs.
